sentences.en: The war was renewed in 1688 and continued until 1697, when the peace of Ryswick confirmed definitively the annexation of Strassburg to France.

sentences.en: It was occupied by the Americans in August 1846, then (without bloodshed) by the Californians in October, and again definitively by the American forces on the 27th of November 1846.

sentences.en: Little is definitively known about what causes dreams.

sentences.en: Specialized instruments and lab technicians monitor sleep patterns, body movements, and brain waves, and a doctor uses the results of the sleep study to diagnose sleep disorders definitively.
sentences.vi: Các kỹ thuật viên phòng thí nghiệm và dụng cụ chuyên dụng theo dõi các kiểu giấc ngủ, chuyển động cơ thể và sóng não, đồng thời bác sĩ sử dụng kết quả của nghiên cứu giấc ngủ để chẩn đoán xác định chứng rối loạn giấc ngủ.

sentences.en: If an infection is suspected or if an abrasion does not heal, then swabbing of the eye for microscopic culture may be done to definitively establish the organism involved.

sentences.en: While parents may reject the idea of an autopsy because they feel it violates their infant's remains, it is often the only tool that can definitively rule out other potential causes of death.

sentences.en: Before the development of genetic testing, there was no way to definitively identify which children had inherited the defective gene.
